clause: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (Act 22 of 2023), section 8(3)
obligation: A data fiduciary must ensure that personal data used to make a decision affecting a data principal is complete, accurate and consistent.
caveat: The Act has no anti-discrimination clause. Section 1(2) leaves commencement to a government notification, which we do not hold. One saved file named DPDP_Act.pdf is actually the Rules 2025.
to_verify: confirm which held file is the Act and which is the Rules
